description: This Java source file defines the ThingSupervisorActor class, which manages the lifecycle, supervision, and restart logic of ThingPersistenceActor instances in an Akka-based actor system. It includes methods for creating actor properties, handling entity IDs, configuring shutdown behaviors, and exception handling related to things in the system.

classes.name: ThingSupervisorActor
classes.description: An Akka actor responsible for supervising ThingPersistenceActor instances, handling actor lifecycle, restarts with exponential back-off, and exposing factory methods and configuration.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for constructing a ThingSupervisorActor with required dependencies.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Decodes the actor's name to derive the associated ThingId.

methods.name: getPersistenceActorProps
methods.description: Provides the Props for creating a specific ThingPersistenceActor based on the entity ID.

methods.name: getShutdownBehaviour
methods.description: Returns the shutdown behavior for the given entity ID.

methods.name: getUnavailableExceptionBuilder
methods.description: Builds an exception indicating the Thing is unavailable.

methods.name: getExponentialBackOffConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the exponential back-off configuration for restarts from system settings.
